mentions.name: Roscoe
mentions.description: A homebuilt computer based on the Motorola 68030 CPU, built with period-appropriate CPLDs instead of an FPGA. The working system already includes a math coprocessor, SRAM, DRAM, and other device support, and a custom-designed VGA card is about to be produced for debugging. Built as a fun exercise in first-principles debugging, building tools, and using vintage equipment like an old logic analyzer.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A 68030 based computer - https://github.com/jeffsponaugle/roscoe

It has been a super fun experience so far - I'm using CPLDs instead of an FPGA which makes the logic a bit more era period.  I have a working system now with the math coprocessor, SRAM, DRAM, and other device support.
